CkRecord.title: CkRecord
CkRecord.description: A construction kit record definition, used at attribute types

recordId.description: Record identifier in Pascal Case with optional namespace (e.g., 'FieldFilter', 'Theme.Colors', 'FieldFilter-1')

derivedFromCkRecordId.description: Reference to base record in Pascal Case (e.g., '${this}/BaseRecord')

recordKey.description: Name of the sub-attribute that identifies an element of this record inside a record array (AB#5528). Required when the record (or a base record) contains a Secret sub-attribute: when a record array is replaced, a secret the client left empty is carried over from the stored element with the same key. The key attribute must be a required String, Int, Int64 or Enum attribute of the record. Inherited by derived records unless they declare their own.
